summary: aTyr Pharma filed an 8-K attaching a prospectus supplement and Cooley legality opinion for an at-the-market program allowing sales of common stock with an aggregate offering price of up to $79,994,251 under its Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-289360, effective August 18, 2025). Sales occur from time to time under the Open Market Sale Agreement dated April 22, 2022, as amended December 23, 2024, with Jefferies LLC as sales agent. No price per share, discount, premium, or closing date is stated. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any overhang from future ATM draws.
